views.name: v_patient_lab
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_patient_lab AS SELECT Patient.ID AS patient_id, Patient.SEX AS sex, Patient.Birthday AS birthday, Patient.Admission AS admission, Patient.Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis, Laboratory.Date AS lab_date, Laboratory.GOT, Laboratory.GPT, Laboratory.LDH, Laboratory.ALP, Laboratory.TP, Laboratory.ALB, Laboratory.UA, Laboratory.UN, Laboratory.CRE, Laboratory."T-BIL" AS t_bil, Laboratory."T-CHO" AS t_cho, Laboratory.TG, Laboratory.CPK, Laboratory.GLU, Laboratory.WBC, Laboratory.RBC, Laboratory.HGB, Laboratory.HCT, Laboratory.PLT, Laboratory.PT, Laboratory.APTT, Laboratory.FG, Laboratory.CRP, Laboratory.IGG, Laboratory.IGA, Laboratory.IGM, Patient.Description, Patient."First Date", Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.RNP, Laboratory.SM, Laboratory.SC170, Laboratory.SSB, Laboratory.CENTROMEA FROM Patient LEFT JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

views.name: v_patient_exam
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_patient_exam AS SELECT Patient.ID AS patient_id, Patient.SEX AS sex, Patient.Birthday AS birthday, Patient.Admission AS admission, Examination."Examination Date" AS exam_date, Examination."aCL IgG" AS acl_igg, Examination."aCL IgM" AS acl_igm, Examination.ANA, Examination."ANA Pattern" AS ana_pattern, Examination.Diagnosis AS exam_diagnosis, Examination.Symptoms AS symptoms, Examination.Thrombosis AS thrombosis, Patient.Description, Patient."First Date", Patient.Diagnosis, Examination.ID, Examination."aCL IgA", Examination.KCT, Examination.RVVT, Examination.LAC FROM Patient LEFT JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID

views.name: v_examination_laboratory_patient
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_examination_laboratory_patient AS SELECT Laboratory.ID, Laboratory.Date, Laboratory.GOT, Laboratory.GPT, Laboratory.LDH, Laboratory.ALB, Laboratory.UA, Laboratory.UN, Laboratory.CRE, Laboratory."T-BIL", Laboratory."T-CHO", Laboratory.TG, Laboratory.CPK, Laboratory.GLU, Laboratory.WBC, Laboratory.RBC, Laboratory.HGB, Laboratory.HCT, Laboratory.PLT, Laboratory.PT, Laboratory.FG, Laboratory.IGG, Laboratory.IGA, Laboratory.IGM, Laboratory.CRP, Laboratory.RNP, Laboratory.SM, Laboratory.SC170, Laboratory.SSB, Laboratory.CENTROMEA, Patient.ID AS Patient_ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday, Patient.Description, Patient."First Date", Patient.Admission, Patient.Diagnosis, Examination.ID AS Examination_ID, Examination."Examination Date", Examination."aCL IgG", Examination."aCL IgM", Examination."ANA Pattern", Examination."aCL IgA", Examination.KCT, Examination.RVVT, Examination.LAC, Examination.Symptoms, Examination.Thrombosis FROM Laboratory LEFT JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.id = Patient.id LEFT JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.id = Examination.id
